study: Equal-volume controls for ray-equivalent intrinsic extent correction
cohort: The same 9310 exposed Ordinary Validation descriptions, with exactly the same changed cases and retained volume per description as the sealed ray-equivalent correction.
scope: Post-result mechanism audit, with control formulas fixed before their candidate generation and scoring. No choice or fit from any target GT.
fixed: face anchoring convention and contact bottom
measured inlier and original first-entry constraints
relative volume of the corrected box on every description

controls.uniform: At a common dimension-relative shrink fraction, saturate each axis at its independently computed feasible maximum. Solve for the fraction that exactly matches the proposed box volume.
controls.height_first: Remove volume from height up to its feasible limit, then distribute any remaining contraction with equal feasible fractions along the two horizontal axes. Match the proposed volume exactly.

comparison: Use the sealed ray-equivalent proposal plus the two matched controls. Verify preserved measurements, identical original Selection hits and first depths, and held-out Audit differences before scoring. Compare Acc@50 and mIoU with the development baseline and across the three axis allocations.
